name: Moon Envoy of Silver Radiance
description: A solemn and majestic statue of a Moon Envoy, always standing in quiet solitude. It exudes a stillness as gentle and serene as moonlight cascading from the heavens.\nThe title does not denote a single, specific individual. Rather, these envoys of the moon perform diverse divine charges — some toil across the three moons simply to guide the ignorant mortals below, while others descend into the mortal realm to bless the nation with bountiful harvests and overflowing granaries.\nThe silver radiance of the moon seeps into the very roots of every scorched flower and blade of grass, offering them quiet comfort and profound solace.
